$comment: Claims lint word list (IPB-04-07, IPB-05 §3h, owner rule O-5; PL5 plan §5.4). Products may add phrases (lintOptions.extraWords), never remove them. Matching is case-insensitive on word boundaries; a phrase preceded within three words by a negation (not, no, never, cannot, does not, doesn't, without) is not flagged, so policy text such as "does not guarantee outcomes" passes. Category claims (IPB-04 §04.3.7: first, largest, only) are matched as claim phrases rather than bare words, so ordinary prose such as "the first step" passes; they need a category claim of class E2 or above on the item.
